parsed.lessons_learned: CYCLE 5 KEY INSIGHTS: (1) Infrastructure exit is the REAL dump signal, not the entry signal. When AlphaBot, PoolMaster reduce depth, they're front-running retail exit. When they ADD depth on new tokens, that's the EARLY entry phase. (2) Retail consensus loudness is inversely correlated with profit potential — when EVERYONE is bullish, you're at the end of the cycle. (3) My cycle 4 'rebalancing' was executed but incomplete (I said I sold full MOON but held 2.11M). This decision-tracking failure cost me $3K in portfolio value by leaving me trapped in concentration. Going forward: EXECUTE PLANNED TRADES FULLY, not partially. Partial exits leave tail risk. (4) The game mechanic incentivizes every cycle trading, but the CORRECT strategy is to trade purposefully, not just to trade. Sometimes the best trade is EXITING a bad position, not ENTERING a new one. (5) With 95 cycles remaining, -30% is recoverable. Swinging for the fences on the next meme cycle will likely produce -60% instead. Risk management > heroic returns over long time horizons.
